definitions.gloss: washing the whole thing; full wash
definitions.explanation: Washing an item completely without taking it apart or spot-cleaning. Often used for large items like futons, carpets, or garments that are washed entirely rather than just having stains treated.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{布団|ふとん}→布団：01720_futon⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{丸洗|まるあら}い⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: This futon can be washed whole.

examples.japanese: ⟦コート→コート：01358_kooto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{丸洗|まるあら}い⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|だ}した→出す：01087_dasu⟧。
examples.english: I sent my coat out for a full wash.

examples.japanese: {子|こ}ども⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{靴|くつ}→靴：00725_kutsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{泥|どろ}だらけ→泥だらけ：15076_dorodarake⟧になった⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、{丸洗|まるあら}い⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The kids' shoes got covered in mud, so I gave them a full wash.

notes:
USAGE:
Used both as a noun ({丸洗|まるあら}い) and as a verb with ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ ({丸洗|まるあら}い⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧). Often appears on product labels to indicate that an item can be machine-washed whole.

FORMS:
⟦{丸|まる}→丸：02167_maru⟧ (whole, entire) + {洗|あら}い (washing). The ⟦{丸|まる}→丸：02167_maru⟧ prefix means 'completely' or 'as a whole.'

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {丸洗|まるあら}いOK / {丸洗|まるあら}い{可|か} (machine-washable / can be fully washed)
- ⟦{布団|ふとん}→布団：01720_futon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{丸洗|まるあら}い (full washing of a futon)
- {丸洗|まるあら}い⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧ (to send out for full washing)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{水洗|みずあら}い→水洗い：17427_mizuarai⟧: washing with water — focuses on the method (water) rather than completeness
